briefdescription.para: Non-zero if the function has base pointer and makes call to llvm.eh.sjlj.setjmp.

detaileddescription.para: When non-zero, the value is a displacement from the frame pointer to a slot where the base pointer is stashed.

briefdescription.para: Size of the callee-saved register portion of the stack frame in bytes.

briefdescription.para: The number of bytes by which return address stack slot is moved as the result of tail call optimization.
keeps track of the virtual register initialized for use as the global base register.

detaileddescription.para: This is used for PIC in some PIC relocation models.

briefdescription.para: FrameIndex for start of varargs area.

detaileddescription.para: This field holds the virtual register into which the sret argument is passed.
